title: DC-area forecast: Mild today before shower chances rise Sunday; cooler, wetter pattern ahead
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly sunny with seasonable afternoon highs in the upper 70s to near 80. Lower humidity adds to the pleasant feel.

What’s next? Rain chances increase tomorrow and stick around through at least midweek. A noticeable cooldown arrives by Tuesday, with highs only in the 60s perhaps for a few days.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Decent sunshine, some cloudier times, and humidity has backed off nicely for the day! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Mild afternoon highs in the upper 70s to near 80. Skies are generally partly sunny, with some some periods of mostly cloudy, and it's dry other than an isolated passing sprinkle. Lower humidity (dew points not far from 60) keep things feeling comfortable with light winds. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Decent and fairly comfortable this evening with overnight lows dipping to the mid-60s to near 70. Mostly cloudy skies and rising humidity make it feel muggier with time. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Mostly cloudy skies give way to some sun at times, with highs in the upper 70s to mid-80 and a muggier feel (dew points in the mid- and upper 60s). Could see a few showers in the morning, especially north and west of DC, then a few more showers and a storm are possible area-wide in the afternoon. Winds are somewhat breezy from the south with gusts up to 20 mph. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Showers and some rumbles are possible during the evening and overnight, with potential for a couple of downpours. Muggy lows are again in the mid-60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

A mostly cloudy and noticeably cooler start to the workweek arrives Monday, with highs in the low to mid-70s and dew points in the 60s keeping it a bit humid. A shower is possible at just about any time, but the best chance for scattered showers should be later in the afternoon and evening. Confidence: Low-Medium

Tuesday brings even cooler highs in the low to mid-60s. Dew points in the low 60s keep some humidity around, while waves of rain remain possible. Some late-day showers could produce heavy downpours. Winds turn a bit breezier, with gusts up to around 30 mph possible Tuesday into Wednesday. Confidence: Medium-Low

The cool and cloudy pattern looks to continue Wednesday and Thursday, with highs in the 60s and periodic showers possible. Temperatures look to tick up by Thursday. Lower rain chances are possible by Friday. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 19

A remarkable late-season heat wave in 1895 began with a 96-degree day and went on to set records for five straight days—an intensity rarely seen so late in September.
